build_2d_resnet: build a two-dimensional ResNet tower with configurable layers, atrous rates, and channel dimensions using make_two_dim_resnet
build_separable_res_layer: build a separable residual block with 1x1 bottleneck, spatial convolution, and skip connection using make_sep_res_layer
create_resnet_with_batch_norm: create a 2D ResNet with batch normalization enabled across all residual layers using make_two_dim_resnet
create_resnet_with_dropout: create a 2D ResNet with configurable dropout probability applied to residual layer outputs using make_two_dim_resnet
create_resnet_with_separable_conv: create a 2D ResNet that uses depthwise separable convolutions in residual blocks via the channel_multiplier parameter
